name: temporal
description: What was I working on N days ago? Phrased as a fixed day-count rather than a weekday name ('last Tuesday') so the scenario is deterministic regardless of which day the suite actually runs on. The harness backdates this session's message timestamps by `days_ago` after the turn completes.

turns: I'm spending today debugging the retrieval pipeline performance issue.
